description:
This role is a hybrid opportunity for candidates to work in office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays from our Seattle, San Francisco, or Detroit offices and work remotely all other days . We can consider highly qualified candidates on a remote only basis who reside outside of these three areas.  
 


 Redfin is one of the most recognized names in residential real estate, a technology-powered brokerage and search platform that has spent two decades reshaping how people find, tour, buy, sell, and rent a home. Millions of people start their housing search on Redfin every month. Together, Redfin and its Rentals network, including Rent. and ApartmentGuide, reach more than 50 million monthly visitors across the housing market. 

 Redfin is now part of Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), joining Rocket Mortgage, Mr. Cooper, Rocket Homes, Rocket Close, Rocket Money, and Rocket Loans in a single connected ecosystem spanning search, financing, closing, servicing, and everyday personal finance. That combination puts Redfin at the front of the largest homeownership platform in the country, and gives its product teams a view of the client journey that no standalone portal or brokerage can match. 

 Redfin’s Rental Team is currently seeking a mid level Full-Stack Software Developer. The Rentals Team is responsible for building features that empower a user’s rental search journey. Our team develops on the Rental Details Page and the Search map, two of the highest traffic page types for Redfin.com. Our full-stack team builds highly visible consumer facing UI as well as robust data ingestion pipelines and data services. By joining our team, you’ll have a chance to work on features that get seen by millions of users and work on multiple critical platforms and services.  

 About our Team 
 High impact and high visibility. We develop and maintain the highest visibility pages on redfin.com. Our work serves millions of customers daily and is the essential top of the funnel for Redfin’s businesses. 
 Full Stack Full Ownership. We own our features from end to end. We build the pipelines to get data into databases all the way to the UI a user sees. 
 Performance is critical. Because our features attract so much traffic, everything we develop must meet strict performance criteria. We dictate performance initiatives and best practices for the rest of the company because we have the most expertise and experience.   
   
 About the role  
 You will develop responsive, resilient, scalable, and high-quality software using React-JS, Java, AWS, and various other tools/libraries. 
 You will leverage AI to develop solutions, innovations, and efficiencies as we move to an AI first development mindset. 
 You will balance the trade-offs between complex infrastructure investments and quick, pragmatic solutions to meet specific business needs. 
 You will collaborate with other engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and develop projects, while also collaborating with your team as both a contributor and a feature lead. 
   
 About you  
 You have 3+ years of professional full stack software development experience specifically in ReactJS and Java. 
 You have hands on experience developing and leveraging AI for software efficiencies in a professional capacity 
 You have a proven track record of designing, building, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications. 
 You have an ownership mindset and understand how to overcome hurdles to deliver high impact features 
 You are comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity.  You know how to make recommendations, create solutions, and drive the outcome. 
 You have exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment, handle ambiguity, and empathize with customers. 
   
 What you’ll get  
 Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.  
  
 On-Call Expectations  
This role may include participation in an on-call rotation to support production systems and ensure service reliability. On-call responsibilities may include coverage during nights and weekends. If applicable, frequency and scheduling will be determined by team needs and communicated accordingly.  
  
 About us   
 Redfin is a technology-driven real estate company with the country's most-visited real estate brokerage website. As part of Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), Redfin is creating an integrated homeownership platform from search to close to make the dream of homeownership more affordable and accessible for everyone. Redfin’s clients can see homes first with on-demand tours, easily apply for a home loan with Rocket Mortgage, and save thousands in fees while working with a top local agent.
